summary: Marvel Rivals entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Marvel Rivals
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows live client with high-resolution pack if hardware allows

emulation.notes: Use native Windows or console clients only.

primary.version: Current Marvel Rivals Windows live client with optional high-resolution pack
primary.why: Marvel Rivals is an active live hero shooter available on Windows, PlayStation, and Xbox, and Windows gives the best capture/settings route plus optional high-resolution asset support on Steam.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build from Steam, Epic, or NetEase. Record patch/date, season, region, account unlocks, roster, ranked/casual mode, graphics settings, high-resolution pack state, anti-cheat state, and whether console cross-play was used.

secondary.platform: PlayStation 5 / PlayStation 5 Pro / Xbox Series X/S / PlayStation 4
secondary.exclusive_content: Console controller and platform ecosystem route
secondary.what_to_play: Use for console capture or platform account comparison.
secondary.why: Console is official, but PC has the higher settings/capture ceiling.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC client with configurable graphics, capture tools, and optional high-resolution pack.
all_releases.reason: primary: strongest capture/settings route for the current live service.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 5 / PlayStation 5 Pro / PlayStation 4 / Xbox Series X/S
all_releases.reason: secondary: console/account comparison, not the fidelity winner.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service seasons, heroes, maps, balance, events, and monetization change by patch; console and PC share the core game but differ in settings and platform account state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact patch/season and account unlocks; anti-cheat and live balance mean captures are time-specific.
